_comment: Per-test kept-red expectation manifest (required since #1806 r11 — the runner fails loud when a declared proof lacks it). The declared test MUST fail with an AssertionError on correct code.

expectedRed.testName: RED: with blanket *.g.cs exclusion, non-generated .g.cs files are masked
expectedRed.why: On correct code isSpecFile() returns false for arbitrary .g.cs files (only ResponseKeys.g.cs is in GENERATED_FILE_PATHS), so the assertion that it returns true fails with an AssertionError. If this test passes, the blanket *.g.cs pattern was restored.
